note: The canonical body every garment for this archetype is fitted to once: MPFB2's MakeHuman base mesh (CC0; 13,380 body vertices plus MPFB's helper geometry, which is never exported) at neutral macros, 1.80 m, in MPFB's rest A-pose, with the ARKit-52 face units and the production skeleton. A character is an instance: its own macros (a controlled morph of this body), its identity (head shape, skin, eyes, hair) and an outfit of garments for this archetype.

morphs.how: MPFB macro targets at instance build; garments follow through build_character.py's conform (a Surface Deform bound on the canonical body)
